note: Highest-reasoning / flagship living comparison for /ai landing (#aiBench). Twelve rows: Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5 (added 29 Sep 2026; Terminal-Bench 4.0 and CursorBench 4.0; AA Index 56, effort max, fetched 2 Oct 2026), Claude Haiku 5.5 (added 7 Oct 2026; AA Index 43, effort max, fetched 7 Oct 2026; AA Index only), Claude Fable 5.1 · GPT-6 Astra · GPT-6.1 Sol (added 29 Sep 2026; DeepSWE v1.1 High 75.2% from the company announce chart; OSWorld and AutomationBench blank because the Sol card commits only that DeepSWE line; AA Index 52, effort max, fetched 2 Oct 2026 from intelligenceIndex 51.83) · Grok 4.7 · Gemini 4 Argon (added 1 Oct 2026; DeepSWE 77.9% and AutomationBench 51.3% are lab claims; AA Index 53) · Muse Wonder (added 12 Oct 2026; Meta returns with Wonder; DeepSWE v1.1 78.8% is a lab claim; Terminal-Bench, OSWorld and AutomationBench blank because Meta prints 4.0-AA, V2.1 and -AA versions that do not match these columns; AA Index 52, effort max, fetched 12 Oct 2026) · Kimi K3.1 Pro (added 24 Oct 2026; weights promised by 4 Nov; DeepSWE v1.1 75.5%, Terminal-Bench 4.0 65.7% and HLE 70.0% with tools are lab claims; OSWorld and AutomationBench blank because Moonshot prints V2.1 and -AA versions that do not match these columns; AA Index 55, fetched 24 Oct 2026; aaIndex effort is null because the AA page shows one entry with no effort label, an exception to the always-store-effort rule) · GPT-6.1 Terra (added 26 Oct 2026; Terminal-Bench 4.0 50.3% at max effort is a lab claim; OSWorld blank because OpenAI prints OSWorld 2.1, which does not match this column; AA Index 48, effort max, fetched 26 Oct 2026)) · Gemini 4 Carbon (added 28 Oct 2026; Google frontier model, Fairwind cyber defenders first, not generally available; AA Index 59, effort high, fetched 28 Oct 2026 from the v5.0 leaderboard, #1 on Index v5.0; lab columns blank because Google prints only cyber evals and WebDev Arena, none of which match these columns; Argon stays a live row because Google says Carbon builds on Argon, not that it replaces it). Muse Spark and DeepSeek Flash dropped from the table; their model pages stay live. Shared lab columns only when a lab primary publishes that eval for this SKU. aaIndex is Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (independent composite); never paste aaIndex into CursorBench/OSWorld/ARC. Label AA vs lab in UI. Blank means no shared primary in this pack. Never invent. TypeSafe Jev is not a living-table row; System One section stays on /ai below the agent tools band. CursorBench versions differ (Fable 3.2.0 vs Opus/Grok 4.0): name the version; do not mix without naming. Labels pass 12 Oct 2026: every non-AA cell carries sourceKind lab (company's own claim) or verifier (third party that ran the test, e.g. ARC Prize); null renders as 'not reported'. Astra ARC-AGI-3 now shows ARC Prize Standard harness 62.7% first; the Provider Adapter 99.9% is kept as altSetup. AA Index v5.0 pass 28 Oct 2026: Artificial Analysis replaced Index v4.3.2 with v5.0 on 27 Oct 2026 (nine evals, new scale). All eleven aaIndex cells re-fetched from the v5.0 leaderboard at each row's stored effort; earlier per-row AA numbers in this note are v4.3.2 history. Gemini 4 Carbon was added the same day as a twelfth row at 59 (high), #1 on v5.0 ahead of Claude Opus 5.5 (max) at 58.
